name: Desperate Prayer
summary: In Dolanaar, Laurna Morninglight sends human priests home to Stormwind for further training. A fellow priest has crossed continents to summon them to the Cathedral of Light.

sections.title: A Message from Home
sections.body: In Dolanaar, Priestess Laurna Morninglight brings you word from home. A fellow priest has crossed continents to find you, and Laurna urges you to return without delay. She offers Elune’s blessing and good wishes for your faith as you leave Teldrassil.

sections.title: The Summons to Stormwind
sections.body: Your path leads across the Great Sea to Stormwind City’s Cathedral of Light. High Priestess Laurena guides the Alliance faithful in their spiritual growth. She summons promising acolytes to deepen their devotion and learn Desperate Prayer, an emergency prayer that can save a life in a darkest hour.

faq.q: Who starts the quest Desperate Prayer in Teldrassil?
faq.answer: Laurna Morninglight, a night elf priest trainer in Dolanaar, sends you word from home. A visiting priest has left an urgent message for you.
You travel to the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind City to speak with High Priestess Laurena.

faq.q: Why is a night elf directing a priest to Stormwind?
aliases: why does a night elf send me to stormwind
faq.answer: Laurna Morninglight respects the faith of foreign priests who visit Teldrassil. She passes along messages from the religious leaders in their homelands, even though night elf priests revere Elune.

faq.q: What is the reward for completing this quest?
faq.answer: You gain access to spiritual mentorship and can learn Desperate Prayer, an instantaneous healing prayer from High Priestess Laurena.

faq.q: Can night elf priests take this specific quest?
aliases: can night elves do desperate prayer
faq.answer: No. Night elf priests worship Elune and learn Starshards. This summons is for human priests exploring Kalimdor at early levels.

faq.q: How do you travel back to Stormwind from Teldrassil?
aliases: how to get to stormwind from dolanaar
faq.answer: Travel through Darnassus to Rut'theran Village, then take a boat to Auberdine in Darkshore. From there, board the ship across the sea to Stormwind Harbor.

angles.text: As a priest, you return to the Cathedral of Light at level ten to learn the blessings of faith tied to your race.
As an Alliance member, you see night elf priestesses coordinate with the church leadership in Stormwind.
As a night elf, you revere Elune, and Priestess Laurna Morninglight still respects foreign followers of the Holy Light beneath Teldrassil’s boughs.
